rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for having ordinary clothes on, including wearing them habitually; it does not cover accessories such as glasses.

example.english: I wear a shirt to work every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 faan1 gung1 dou1 zoek3 seot1 saam1

rows.note: Use this for wearing accessories or items on the head, face, eyes, or ears, especially glasses, rather than ordinary clothing.

example.english: I always wear glasses when I go out.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 jat1 ding6 daai3 ngaan5 geng2

rows.note: Use this when something gradually drains or exhausts a person, their energy, or their patience.

example.english: This job can wear me out.
example.traditional: 呢份工真係好消耗精神。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu1 hou3 zing1 san4

rows.note: Use this when repeated use or friction wears something through, such as wearing a hole in clothing or shoes.

example.english: My old sneakers wear through quickly.
example.traditional: 我對舊波鞋好快就磨穿。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gau6 bo1 haai4 hou2 faai3 zau6 mo4 cyun1
